_original_lore: When placed on your island, it will
inspire your minions with the belief
that they too, might one day be given
the choice to leave if they work
All minions on your island will work 5%
Your Inferno Minion II sent you a
mountain on a very, very distant
name: 明信片

source: When placed on your island, it will
inspire your minions with the belief
that they too, might one day be given
the choice to leave if they work
loreParagraphs.translation: 放置在你的岛屿上时,它会激励你的仆从,让它们相信只要足够努力,有朝一日或许也能获得离开的选择.

source: All minions on your island will work {{N0}}
loreParagraphs.translation: 你岛屿上的所有仆从工作速度提高 {{N0}}.

source: Your Inferno Minion II sent you a
mountain on a very, very distant
loreParagraphs.translation: 你的炼狱仆从 II 给你寄来了一张绝美照片,画面中是一座位于极其遥远岛屿上的高耸山峰.
